question: What is Grab's dividend policy, according to its FY2025 annual report?

text:
Based on Grab's FY2025 20-F, Grab has no formal commitment to pay dividends. Its board of directors has complete discretion over whether to declare and pay any dividends, and the timing, amount and form of future dividends (if any) would depend on factors such as future results of operations and cash flow, capital requirements and surplus, distributions received from subsidiaries and consolidated affiliated entities, financial condition, contractual restrictions, and other factors the board deems relevant [Grab, FY2025, p.49, 50].

Rather than paying dividends, Grab has instead opted to return capital to shareholders through share repurchases: in February 2026, its board authorized a share repurchase program allowing the buyback of up to $500 million worth of Class A Ordinary Shares. This program has no fixed end date, does not obligate Grab to repurchase any specific amount of shares, and may be suspended or terminated at any time [Grab, FY2025, p.49, 50].

Rather than paying dividends, Grab has instead opted to return capital to shareholders through share repurchases: in February 2026, its board authorized a share repurchase program allowing the buyback of up to $500 million worth of Class A Ordinary Shares. This program has no fixed end date, does not obligate Grab to repurchase any specific amount of shares, and may be suspended or terminated at any time [Grab, FY2025, p.49, 50].
